Get Available Monosaacharides

Source: R/monosaccharide.R
available_monosaccharides.Rd

This function returns a character vector of monosaccharide names of the given type. See get_mono_type() for monosaacharide types. Concrete furanose forms use an f after the monosaccharide stem, such as Galf and GlcfNAc. Generic names do not encode ring form.

Usage

available_monosaccharides(mono_type = "all")

Arguments

mono_type

A character string specifying the type of monosaccharides. Can be "all", "generic", or "concrete". Default is "all".

Value

A character vector of monosaccharide names.

Examples

available_monosaccharides()
#>   [1] "Hex"       "HexNAc"    "HexN"      "HexA"      "dHex"      "dHexNAc"  
#>   [7] "ddHex"     "Pen"       "NeuAc"     "NeuGc"     "gNeu"      "gKdn"
